words.meaning: A place of residence; a house or home.
sentences: They established a permanent abode in the peaceful countryside.
The ancient castle was once the abode of royalty.

words.meaning: An entrance hall or open area near the front door of a house.
sentences: She hung her coat in the foyer after coming inside.
The spacious foyer of the house was decorated with flowers.
Guests were warmly greeted in the main foyer.

words.meaning: The floor or strip at the bottom of a doorway crossed when entering a house.
sentences: He paused at the threshold before stepping inside the house.
It is a custom in many cultures to carry the bride over the threshold.
She stood on the threshold and waved goodbye to her guests.
